title: Add live event feed from durable audit and runtime projections
purpose: Show live operator-relevant events without making event cursors authoritative.
scope: Define EventCursor over durable projection snapshots.
Render latest audit, run, approval, recovery and support events in a bounded feed.
Support deterministic replay with fixed event order.
Show source freshness and degraded source warnings.
Avoid polling side effects or hidden runtime mutation.
acceptance_criteria: Event feed is derived from durable sources only.
Refreshing the event feed does not mutate run state.
Degraded or missing event sources remain visible.
failure_modes: Event cursor becomes recovery source of truth.
Feed refresh creates nondeterministic replay output.
